Theme

Latin word

videor

videor, vidērī, vīsus sum

verb, second conjugation: the passive of videō, with a nominative and infinitive

seem, appear (to be or to do)

In this lexicon

  • seem

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Off. 1.83: ut imbellēs timidīque videāmur; Traupman 376

Examples

  • nōn semper ea sunt quae videntur

    things are not always what they seemPhaedr. 4.2.5

    In the entry for seem

  • nunc ego tibi īrāscī videor?

    do I seem angry to you now?Gell. 1.26.8

    In the entry for seem

  • quia videor ācer, alligant mē interdiū

    because I seem fierce, they tie me up by dayPhaedr. 3.7.15–20

    In the entry for seem

  • aliquid natābat quod prīmō aspectū alga ipsa vidēbātur

    something was swimming that at first sight seemed to be the seaweed itselfLibellus V, Lisbōna: castellum et ōceanārium
